summary: Mr. Harari discusses the customs for the prayers following the Amida on Motsae Shabbat. He talks about the Halabi custom regarding the pesukim, whether to stand or sit, and what is done when Yom Tov falls during the week. He also mentions the distribution of Besamim before Havdalah.
questions: What is the Halabi custom for the pesukim after the Amida on Motsae Shabbat?
Do we stand or sit when saying these pesukim according to the Aleppo custom?
Why do we omit a certain pasuk when Yom Tov falls during the week?
When are the Besamim given out during the service?
